fact_storm_night.text: On the night Aldric Thorne died, a sudden squall blew in off the headland. The lighthouse beam held until just past the third hour, then went dark.

fact_keeper_threatened.text: In the week before his death, Aldric Thorne had told his wife Irene that he had refused to look the other way for a cargo brought in after curfew.

fact_smuggler_pact.text: Maeve and two other dockhands had a standing arrangement to land sealed cargo on dark nights at the tide-gate pier, paid in coin and silence.

fact_chest_at_pier.text: A salt-stained chest still waits under tarpaulin at the tide-gate pier. Irene believes it is the cargo Aldric refused, and that it is what got him killed.

fact_constable_inquiry_open.text: The deputy constable, Tomas Vell, has formally opened an inquiry into the death and is the only person authorized to issue a writ for the pier.
